identificationModule.briefTitle: Treatment of Patients With Major Depressive Disorder With MK0869 (0869-063)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Double-Blind, Multicenter, Placebo Controlled, Acute and Extension Study of 2 Doses of MK0869 in the Treatment of Patients With Major Depressive Disorder

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A clinical study to determine the efficacy and safety of MK0869 in the treatment of depression.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: The duration of treatment is 8 weeks.

primaryOutcomes.measure: HAMD-17 total score at week 8. Tolerability.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: CGI-I Scale score at week 8 and at least a 50% reduction in the HAMD-17 total score.
